threads.body: The OpenAI JavaScript SDK supports automatic tool calling through `chat.completions.runTools()`, which runs supplied functions and sends their results back. The Python-only exception at `scenarios/gen-ai/README.md:97–100` therefore does not apply to this row. That contract requires a scenario for every supported class, even when the instrumentation does not emit the corresponding telemetry. Add an `automatic_tool_calling` workload using the SDK-managed loop, add its instrumented entry point and `conformance.yaml` registration, update this row, and regenerate `data.json`. Otherwise this class is omitted from measurement rather than exposing any instrumentation gaps.

threads.body:
Every JS gen-ai `data.json` (OpenAI too) has about 12 `host.*` / `process.*` resource findings. They come from `NodeSDK`'s default resource detectors in the scenario SDK, not from the instrumentation under test, and Python results don't have them. Could we either turn the detectors off in [`tools/js/scenario-sdk/index.js`](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-conformance/blob/main/tools/js/scenario-sdk/index.js#L86):

```js
const sdk = new NodeSDK({ instrumentations, resourceDetectors: [] });
```

or filter them in [`tools/gen-ai/runner/src/genai_conformance/weaver.toml`](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-conformance/blob/main/tools/gen-ai/runner/src/genai_conformance/weaver.toml)?

```toml
# Resource attributes the Node SDK's default detectors set.
[[live-check.finding_filters]]
signal_type = "resource"
exclude_samples = [
  "host.arch",
  "host.id",
  "host.name",
  "process.command",
  "process.command_args",
  "process.executable.name",
  "process.executable.path",
  "process.owner",
  "process.pid",
  "process.runtime.description",
  "process.runtime.name",
  "process.runtime.version",
]
```

The scenario SDK is shared with the HTTP JS scenarios, so the first option needs their `data.json` files re-checked.

replies.body: I used the GenAI-only filter to keep HTTP's process-runtime coverage intact.
